name: Beauty Kills the Beast
source:
You are dragged to the palace by guards who accuse you of stealing. There, you make a shocking discovery about yourself.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
卫兵们指控你犯下盗窃之罪，强行将你拖进了王宫。而在那里，你竟揭开了关于自己身世的惊人真相。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
